quest.title: Business in a Marsh
quest.description: Huai'an can't stop worrying about the roaming monsters near Wangshu Inn...

dialogues.speaker: Huai'an
dialogues.text: *sigh* It's just one thing after another...

dialogues.speaker: Huai'an
dialogues.text: This location... It's a real challenge to run an inn here.

dialogues.speaker: Huai'an
dialogues.text: It could just be me, but I feel like we're seeing more and more monsters around these parts recently.

dialogues.speaker: Huai'an
dialogues.text: They wouldn't dare come anywhere near the inn itself, but guests need to get in and out and the Millelith can't be here all the time.

dialogues.speaker: Huai'an
dialogues.text: If you're free, do you think you could take a look around and clear out any monsters nearby?

response.speaker: Huai'an
response.text: Haha... Ah, I must say I do find your forthrightness refreshing...

response.speaker: Huai'an
response.text: Speaking of tiring jobs... I do feel bad making you do this.

response.speaker: Huai'an
response.text: But I promise I will make it worth your time.

response.speaker: Huai'an
response.text: Best of luck, and thank you.

response.speaker: Huai'an
response.text: Yes, we should have known what we were getting into when we chose the location.

response.speaker: Huai'an
response.text: But then, where would passing travelers stay if it weren't for us?

response.speaker: Huai'an
response.text: It's a tiring job, but a necessary one.

dialogues.speaker: Huai'an
dialogues.text: How's it coming along? All clear?

dialogues.speaker: Huai'an
dialogues.text: Okay. Well, take your time. These monsters may be no end of trouble to people coming and going, but they wouldn't dare set foot in the inn itself.

dialogues.speaker: Huai'an
dialogues.text: And in the highly unlikely event that a few of the gutsier ones did venture inside... I'm sure I could, ahem, persuade them to leave. My guests' safety would not be at risk.

dialogues.speaker: Huai'an
dialogues.text: No one runs an inn this far out of town unless they know a bit of self-defense!

dialogues.speaker: Huai'an
dialogues.text: How's it coming along? All clear?

dialogues.speaker: Huai'an
dialogues.text: These days, honestly... If I hadn't done martial arts since I was a kid, I wouldn't dream about working in the hospitality sector.
